plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/modal\/he.Aucun compteur reçu : le collecteur n’a: No meter readings received: the data collector has not yet transmitted any readings.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/modal\/he.Aucune base importée. Fonction facultati: No database imported. Optional feature; has no effect on the start of data collection.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/modal\/he.Collecte inactive : derniers compteurs r: Inactive data collection: latest meter readings received, without evaluation of the current period.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/modal\/he.Les compteurs indiquent des événements p: Counters track lost events, not the number of bytes. Losses can result in incomplete volumes.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/modal\/he.Si le collecteur ne démarre pas, son dia: If the manifold does not start, its system diagnostics are available via:

plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.Analyse locale, sans télémétrie ni lectu: Local analysis, without telemetry or monitoring of communication content.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.Barres : reçu et envoyé sur chaque inter: Bars: received and sent during each interval. Periods with no observations do not indicate an absence of traffic.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.Cette vue reste indépendante du filtre a: This view remains unaffected by whether the filter is enabled or disabled: these processes do not have an established plugin status. The buttons open their destinations for the selected time period.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.Choisissez un plugin dans le filtre des: Select a plugin from the exchange filter below. The diagnostic tool monitors activity for two minutes; then, manually trigger a refresh or a command in the selected plugin. No devices are controlled automatically.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.Cliquez sur un plugin pour explorer ses: Click on a plugin to explore its communications. “Local observed” does not guarantee that all of its functions are autonomous.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.Drapeaux : pays fournis par la base GeoI: Flags: countries provided by the local GeoIP database. House: local network; computer: internal traffic; globe: unknown country. The local peer identifies the other end of a connection without reassigning it the shared server’s storage space.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.La jauge utilise le rafraîchissement con: The gauge uses the configured or declared refresh rate; otherwise, it uses a regular network interval. Jeedom cron jobs remain separate: a maintenance cron job does not define the refresh rate. Hover over the column to view the source of the data point.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.Les filtres d’état et de recherche s’app: Status and search filters apply to tables. Click a column header to sort, then click it again to reverse the order. The counters remain those for the entire period.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.Les pourcentages portent sur les octets: The percentages refer to bytes sent and received locally and over the Internet, excluding internal traffic and unknown destinations. No corresponding traffic: —.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.Pourquoi cette attribution ? Processus r: Why this classification? Recently observed processes
Recent processes with no identified plugin. Volumes remain associated with the process; no plugin can be inferred from the port or address alone.
plugins\/pluginscope\/desktop\/php\/plug.Rechercher un plugin ou une destination: Search for a plugin or a destination

No firewall rules are added. No communication content is logged.
plugins\/pluginscope\/plugin_info\/confi.Cette première version nécessite Debian: This first version requires Debian 12 with a Linux kernel 6.1 or newer, on a 64-bit system. Containers may restrict data collection.
plugins\/pluginscope\/plugin_info\/confi.Comprendre les communications de vos plu: Understand your plugins' communications from your Jeedom.
plugins\/pluginscope\/plugin_info\/confi.Installer ma propre base MMDB: Set up my own MMDB database
plugins\/pluginscope\/plugin_info\/confi.Installez les dépendances puis démarrez: Install the dependencies, then start the daemon from the Jeedom controls. Data collection begins after the eBPF sensors have loaded.
plugins\/pluginscope\/plugin_info\/confi.Les adresses privées et link-local sont: Private and link-local addresses are recognized automatically. Add your other local networks in CIDR notation, one per line. A local proxy can hide an Internet destination.
plugins\/pluginscope\/plugin_info\/confi.Les bases Pays et ASN MaxMind GeoLite2 s: The MaxMind GeoLite2 country and ASN databases are verified and downloaded from the P3TERX mirror when dependencies are installed and when the plugin is updated. Valid files are replaced only by a newer version.
plugins\/pluginscope\/plugin_info\/confi.Les réglages sont transmis au démon au p: The settings are sent to the daemon the next time the Jeedom task runs or when the analysis is opened.
plugins\/pluginscope\/plugin_info\/confi.Seul le téléchargement des bases utilise: Only the database downloads use the Internet. The country lookup remains local: no observed IP addresses are transmitted to the provider.
plugins\/pluginscope\/plugin_info\/confi.Si le réglage d’un démon n’est pas recon: If a daemon’s setting is not recognized automatically, specify its interval in seconds: plugin_id=seconds, one line per plugin. This setting does not affect the operation of the monitored plugin.

plugins\/pluginscope\/plugin_info\/insta.Mise à jour : relancez les dépendances p: Update: Rerun the dependencies and then the daemon to install the updated collector.
